answer: Use a voucher graph with sunk-cost attestations: a new agent can act only after trusted incumbents vouch for it, and each voucher burns a non-refundable fee. Fake identities form hollow clusters whose mutual vouches are discounted because they have no path to the honest core; a Sybil can enter only by bribing a real voucher, whose burned fee and lost standing exceed any reward it could farm. Honest agents reach a haven of high trust, and each climb up the trust terrace demands more unique backers, so scaling an attack means buying more real accomplices, not minting more keys.
